default_parameters.node_count_rule: Use the listed node counts only where cluster allocation limits and system launch support allow.
default_parameters.latency_sampling: Record per-operation latency when client APIs expose timestamps; otherwise report null latency fields and document the limitation in run notes.

deployment_policy.final_target: distributed deployments across allocated compute nodes
deployment_policy.single_node_master_policy: Allowed only for smoke validation of scripts, launch mechanics, logging, and metrics output; does not satisfy final distributed benchmark requirements.
deployment_policy.mode_rule: Record bare_metal or containerized in each run configuration and summary.
deployment_policy.bare_metal_reason: Preferred because later ChronoLog optimization work is expected to depend on proper RDMA/RoCE-capable network configuration.
